newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish bond yields dip, crown steady.
newsitem.headline: Swedish bond yields dip, crown steady.

text.p: 0740 GMT - Swedish bond yields edged lower at the open on Thursday and the crown was trading unchanged.
The market focus was on U.S. labour market statistics for June due later in the session.
The crown was expected to trade in the range of 4.4200 and 4.44690 versus the market.
* Six month T-bill rate flat at 4.11 percent
* Ten year bond yield falls one basis point to 6.55 percent
* Crown unchanged at 4.4315 to mark vs 4.4320 late Wednesday
